name: team_planning_set_assignment
description: Set every place a person holds in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: each a position or a unit, with an allocation above 0 and at most 1 and an optional role. The person's places become exactly this list, and an empty list leaves them unassigned. A place in a position follows the position if it moves. Allocations may total over 1; the scenario map shows the total. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit the list unless they set it again. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

placements.description: Every place the person holds, or none to leave them unassigned.

position_id.description: A position the scenario has. Give this or unit_id, not both.

unit_id.description: A unit, for a place in no position.

role.description: The person's role in the place, such as Lead.
